SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_tasks WHERE status = 'failed'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(llm_cost_yuan), 0) FROM analysis_tasks WHERE status = 'success'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(llm_cost_yuan), 0) FROM analysis_tasks WHERE status = 'success' AND finish_time >= #{start} AND finish_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT stat_date AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(new_users), 0) AS newUsers, COALESCE(SUM(video_count), 0) AS videoCount, COALESCE(SUM(task_success), 0) AS taskSuccess, COALESCE(SUM(task_failed), 0) AS taskFailed, COALESCE(SUM(llm_cost), 0) AS llmCost FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS new_users, 0 AS video_count, 0 AS task_success, 0 AS task_failed, 0 AS llm_cost FROM users WHERE created_time >= #{start} AND created_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(created_time), 0, COUNT(*), 0, 0, 0 FROM videos WHERE deleted_time IS NULL AND created_time >= #{start} AND created_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(finish_time), 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status='success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status='failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='success' THEN llm_cost_yuan ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM analysis_tasks WHERE finish_time IS NOT NULL AND finish_time >= #{start} AND finish_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(finish_time) ) merged GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT task_type AS taskType, COUNT(*) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(llm_input_tokens), 0) AS totalInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(llm_output_tokens), 0) AS totalOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(llm_cost_yuan), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(llm_cost_yuan), 0) AS avgCost FROM analysis_tasks WHERE status = 'success' GROUP BY task_type
